info.desc: COWBOY CARTER is the eighth studio album by American singer-songwriter Beyoncé, released on March 29, 2024, via Parkwood Entertainment and Columbia Records. The album was announced on February 11, 2024, in which was teased through a Verizon commercial aired during the Super Bowl LVIII. It was preceded by two singles that same night, "TEXAS HOLD 'EM" which hit #1 on Billboard Hot 100, and “16 CARRIAGES". It serves as the second instalment of Beyoncé's three-act project recorded during the COVID-19 pandemic, following Grammy nominated-awarded Act I: RENAISSANCE. Along with it being a country album, “COWBOY CARTER” incorporates aspects of blues, .

podcast.body: Beyoncé won the Grammy Award for Best Country Album and Album of the Year for "Cowboy Carter" in 2024. This achievement made her the first African American woman to win a country Grammy since The Pointer Sisters in 1975, 50 years prior. "Beyonce won best country album and album of the year for that matter for Country Carter."
